title: Elbit Systems Awarded Approximately $200 Million in Contracts for Airborne ISTAR and Training Solutions in Asia-Pacific
body_markdown:
Elbit Systems Ltd. announced today that it was awarded contracts in an aggregate value of approximately $200 million from a country in Asia-Pacific for the supply of airborne Intelligence, Surveillance, Target Acquisition and Reconnaissance (“ISTAR”) and Training solutions. The contracts will be performed over a period of up to 5 years.


Under the contracts, Elbit Systems will supply the[SPECTRO™ 12](https://www.elbitsystems.com/air-space/airborne-c4isr/electro-optical-intelligence-systems/spectro-12) multispectral Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance (“ISR”) and targeting payload for integration on helicopters. The[SPECTRO 12](https://www.elbitsystems.com/air-space/airborne-c4isr/electro-optical-intelligence-systems/spectro-12) is the latest addition to Elbit Systems’ SPECTRO family of airborne ISR and targeting payloads, introducing a compact multispectral payload designed for platforms with strict size, weight and power constraints. The SPECTRO 12 combines high-resolution multispectral sensing, precision targeting technologies, including a Laser designator, and AI-powered image processing, enabling long-range target detection, identification, tracking and engagement performance in complex operational environments and adverse weather conditions.


The contracts further include follow-on support and upgrade services for[airborne live training systems](https://www.elbitsystems.com/air-space/training-simulation/embedded-virtual-training/ehud) installed on aircraft and used in live virtual constructive and virtual combat training scenarios. The systems support realistic air-to-air and air-to-ground training, including real-time combat simulation, weapon scoring and mission debriefing capabilities, contributing to enhanced pilot readiness and training effectiveness.


In addition, under the contracts Elbit Systems will supply advanced[Head-Up Display (HUD) systems](https://www.elbitsystems.com/air-space/aircraft-systems/head-displays-hud) . The HUD systems feature high-resolution display technologies, enhanced video capabilities and low power consumption, supporting day and night operations across a range of airborne platforms.


> **Bezhalel (Butzi) Machlis, President and CEO of Elbit Systems:** "Elbit Systems’ airborne solutions combine advanced technologies with extensive operational experience across a wide range of mission environments. We are proud to provide our customers with innovative capabilities that enhance mission effectiveness, situational awareness and operational readiness across a broad spectrum of airborne missions."
